findings.title: UI clicks also place/break world blocks (input leak)
findings.expected: Java: clicking a UI control (placement category tab, block button, toolbar or menu button) is consumed by the UI and never issues a world place/break command
findings.actual: Godot: every left/right press is applied by MindSimHost 'input' (the _input virtual -> sim_host.rs input()) before the GUI consumes it, with no UI-hover/consumed guard. Three category-tab clicks in the placement panel issued place commands for the selected block at the tile under each tab: block_placed stone-wall at (131,59)/(136,59)/(128,59), build_id 0/1/2. A real OS-level click on the Production tab (computer-mcp, not the MCP injector) switched the category AND placed stone-wall at (130,59) build_id 3 (commands_applied 4->5). Main-menu clicks also log 'mouse tile (..) applied (LEFT)' before the sector loads
